target.statement: MGA achieves NMI = 0.8519 (and ARI = 0.8289) on Karate, exceeding the best topology-only baseline by ~20.5%
target.table_ref: Table II (EQ2), Karate row, MGA NMI column; also Fig. 2 (EQ1.1)

compute.basis: No code released; the whole RAM objective (affinity, k-means-binned g(d) calibration, BGD/MGA optimisers, AutoGL embedding pipeline) must be reimplemented from the text, and the exact 0.8519 depends on AutoGL's auto-selected embeddings and 10-run averaging, so matching the number is uncertain even though the Karate graph itself is tiny and CPU-only.
